required_behaviors: Consume exactly K priority job IDs after the standard body.
Validate K=ceil(job_count/4), 0-based range, strict ascending order, uniqueness, and no trailing tokens.
Recompute makespan and max completion over the parsed priority set after every complete decode.
Rank candidates lexicographically by makespan first and priority completion second.
Expose priority-aware dispatch or move ranking while retaining makespan-oriented exploration.
Target priority-job critical operations and their blocking machine arcs without adding hard priority constraints.
Accept an improved secondary objective only when makespan is unchanged.
Verify the complete fixed-evaluator schedule before replacing the incumbent.
Construct or refresh the serialized payload after the final incumbent decision so schedule, makespan, priority_completion_time, and accepted solver evidence all describe the same solution.

coupled_groups.rule: Parsing, search pressure, objective tracking, and acceptance must use the same priority job set and strict lexicographic ordering.
